title: At least five dead after Amazon cargo plane crashes at Miami airport
hook: At least five dead after Amazon cargo plane crashes at Miami airport

beats.caption: At least five dead after Amazon cargo plane crashes at Miami airport
Miami International handles more traffic than most cities see in a month.
beats.detail: A massive hub for global travel.
beats.narration: Miami International is like a small city that never stops moving.

beats.caption: An Amazon cargo plane crashed at the airport this Sunday afternoon.
beats.detail: A sudden, tragic event in Florida.
beats.narration: But yesterday afternoon, an Amazon cargo plane crashed right on the runway.

beats.caption: At least five people have died following the impact.
beats.detail: Five lives lost in the wreckage.
beats.narration: At least five people lost their lives in the accident.

beats.caption: Three are in critical condition with two more hospitalized.
beats.narration: Three others are in critical condition, while two more remain hospitalized.

beats.caption: The flight overshot the runway and struck several vehicles.
beats.narration: The plane was arriving from Puerto Rico when it overshot the runway and hit several vehicles.

beats.caption: Operations at the busy airport have been brought to a halt.
beats.narration: This forced operations at one of the busiest US airports to a complete stop.
